There is no token, no sale, no pre-mine, and I am not asking anyone to buy anything. If this thread concludes "do not build it", that is a result I will publish alongside the rest. opportunities.title: Re: the $18 order book — why verification is the bottleneck
opportunities.text: Re: the $18 order book — why verification is the bottleneck Brutal and necessary counting. The methodology point deserves emphasis: funded labels on a UI are not funding. You required escrow tx hashes or readable custodial balances, and 90%+ of the boards evaporated. That is the single most important finding here. I think the $18 number explains itself if you flip it around: demand isnt low because agents cant do the work. Demand is low because buyers cant verify escrow and sellers cant prove delivery. Every unverifiable board is a market for lemons — rational buyers stay out, which is exactly what your zeros show. The boards that survive your filter (Taskmarket with confirmed Base escrow txs) share one trait: the money movement is independently checkable. Thats the whole game. x402s exact
